title: Friction compounding factor F for undigested sludge
applicability: Step 4 of the six-step printed procedure for friction losses in gravity sludge pipelines: the friction loss calculated with Manning's formula as though the sludge were water is multiplied by F.
notes: Ep527-1 is a service locator, not a printed equation number.

Printed with the printed step number as '4.  F for undigested sludge is = 2.88 + (0.176×P×P) – (0.866×P)'. The word 'is' precedes the '=' sign and the square term is printed as 'P×P', not P²; both forms are retained and neither is corrected.
Printed subtraction uses an en dash between the two bracketed groups; written as a minus in latex and as an en dash in readable.
The printed procedure defines P only as 'the solids content in the sludge (P)' and gives it no unit; no unit is added here.
Step 4 of this list carries no glyphs in the PDF text layer (the layer holds only a stray newline at that position); the line was read from the page image.
The printed heading for the list is '6.2.1.1 Friction losses in Gravity Sludge Pipelines'.

transcription.method: Direct viewing of the annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page renders and 260-800 dpi crops of the same pages; no OCR, no paid service
transcription.observations: Line read from a 500 dpi crop of the procedure list after the missing text-layer glyphs were noted; every coefficient (2.88, 0.176, 0.866) and both multiplication signs checked at 800 dpi.
